entries.title: Psalms 29:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength. {ye mighty: Heb. ye sons of the mighty}

words.text: . {ye mighty: Heb. ye sons of the mighty}

entries.title: Psalms 29:2
segments: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness. {the glory...: Heb. the honour of his name} {in...: or, in his glorious sanctuary}

words.text: . {the glory...: Heb. the honour of his name} {in...: or, in his glorious sanctuary}

entries.title: Psalms 29:3
segments: The voice of the LORD [is] upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD [is] upon many waters. {many: or, great}

entries.title: Psalms 29:4
segments: The voice of the LORD [is] powerful; the voice of the LORD [is] full of majesty. {powerful: Heb. in power} {full...: Heb. in majesty}

words.text: . {powerful: Heb. in power} {full...: Heb. in majesty}

entries.title: Psalms 29:5
segments: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 29:6
segments: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

words.text: He maketh them also to skip

entries.title: Psalms 29:7
segments: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire. {divideth: Heb. cutteth out}

entries.title: Psalms 29:8
segments: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

entries.title: Psalms 29:9
segments: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of [his] glory. {to calve: or, to be in pain} {doth...: or, every whit of it uttereth, etc}

words.text: . {to calve: or, to be in pain} {doth...: or, every whit of it uttereth, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 29:10
segments: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 29:11
segments: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
